positive_claims: a faithful port of fileio.c's cob_chk_file_env + the simple-case path of cob_chk_file_mapping -- how an ORGANIZATION OPEN resolves a COBOL ASSIGN name to a filesystem path, proven to match the admitted libcob's resolution (map_sweep 2/0: the oracle creates each file at exactly the path the Rust mapping predicts): a bare name (no separator, not absolute) is looked up via the environment variables DD_<name>, dd_<name>, <name> in order (with '.' mangled to '_', or all non-alnum under COB_ENV_MANGLE
surrounding quotes stripped), an absolute env value is used as-is, otherwise the name is prefixed by COB_FILE_PATH if set
